mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVATION ( ADMIN_IDX, USER_MAIL, RESV_PRICE, RESV_PEOPLE, RESV_STATUS, RESV_PAY_STATUS, RESV_PAY_METHOD, RESV_ARRIVAL_TIME, RESV_REQUEST, RESV_DAY, RESV_ORDER_ID, RESV_LAST_NAME_EN, RESV_FIRST_NAME_EN, RESV_LAST_NAME_JP, RESV_FIRST_NAME_JP, RESV_MAIL, RESV_COUNTRY, RESV_TEL ) VALUES ( #{adminIdx}, #{userMail}, #{resvPrice}, #{resvPeople}, #{resvStatus}, #{resvPayStatus}, #{resvPayMethod,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resvArrivalTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resvRequest,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resvDay}, #{resvOrderId}, #{resvLastNameEn}, #{resvFirstNameEn}, #{resvLastNameJp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resvFirstNameJp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resvMail}, #{resvCountry}, #{resvTel} )
mapper.select: SELECT RESV_NUM AS resvNum, USER_MAIL AS userMail, RESV_LAST_NAME_EN AS resvLastNameEn, RESV_FIRST_NAME_EN AS resvFirstNameEn, RESV_MAIL AS resvMail FROM RESERVATION WHERE RESV_ORDER_ID = #{resvOrderId}
